facts.fact: CIPESA reports that the Cabinet, meeting on 13 July 2011, adopted the 2010-2025 National ICT Development Plan (PNDTIC) to accelerate economic growth and promote universal ICT access.
CIPESA describes the National ICT Development Plan adopted in 2011 as a 15-year plan covering 2010-2025.

CIPESA states that implementation of the 2010-2025 National ICT Development Plan is well underway, citing 1,250 km of fibre laid by the Burundi Backbone System, and measures it against no target in the plan; the report gives no event date, so its publication date of January 2020 is used.
CIPESA states that in 2007 the government passed the National ICT policy to spur economic development through ICT.
